text:
morgan: Hey team — planning to add a multi-region GPU pool for inference bursts next quarter. Need input on instance-type mix + quotas. Target regions: us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1. Thinking A100-40 + H100-80 mix (70/30). Anyone see quota limits or lead times we should worry about? cc @jia @sam

jia: Quick snapshot from our last check — quotas are tight in some regions. us-west1: A100 32, H100 8; eu-west1: A100 16, H100 0; asia-east1: A100 4, H100 0. Those are soft limits, can request increases but expect 7-14d in some regions.

sam: Thanks. Can you paste expected GPU counts you'd want per region? Also are we doing spot/preemptible blend for cost? Spot saves $$$ but has eviction risk.

morgan: Rough estimate: baseline total 40 A100 + 12 H100 across regions (split based on latency needs). Want a ~50% spot blend for cost. Also want autoscaler headroom ~20% to handle bursts.

ana: For enterprise/Dedicated customers we can't use preemptible for SLA-backed workloads. For hosted bursts it's fine. Also vendor told me H100 capacity in eu-west1 is delayed until late Q2.

morgan: Ok — so plan conservative H100 in EU and fallback to optimized/quantized A100 variants there. Any terraform quota names or preflight checks we should run?

jia: Yep — GCP quota names to check: `COMPUTE_GPUS_ALL_REGIONS`, and region-specific quotas like `GPUS_us-west1_A100`. Quick preflight command: ```bash
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format='json(quotas)'
```

sam: I'll open quota increase requests after we lock numbers. Also pinging our vendor rep: @vendor-bot can you confirm H100 ETA for eu-west1 and whether a dedicated allocation is possible?

vendor-bot: Vendor FYI: H100 capacity in eu-west1 expected ETA 2026-05-10. Dedicated allocation requests typically take 2-3 weeks to provision after contract. :calendar:

morgan: :thinking_face: That pushes our timeline. Proposal: prioritize A100 pool (with 8-bit quantized models) in EU; spin up H100 in US + ASIA for latency-sensitive routes.

ana: Agree. Also re: quotas, when you request increases include `reason: inference-burst-Q3` and an estimated monthly GPU hours number. I'll add procurement contact info to the sheet: https://company.internal/sheets/gpu-capacity-plan

jia: One more infra note: SSH key rotation required for private nodes. Add `worker_pool_ssh_key` to terraform preflight. Quick terraform snippet: ```hcl
resource "google_compute_instance" "gpu" {
  name = "gpu-worker"
  machine_type = "n1-standard-16"
}
```

sam: Submitted to cloud support: quota request #QR-4321. Included estimated hours and cost table. Support ETA ~5 business days. Tagging @morgan for final review of numbers. :eyes: 

morgan: Action items recap: (1) Sam submit quota requests (2) Ana update spreadsheet + vendor/procurement contact (3) Jia add terraform preflight checklist + commands (4) Morgan to draft rollout playbook with A100 fallback. Ping here when requests are submitted.

deploy-bot: Quota request #QR-4321 submitted by sam. Status: pending cloud support review.

sam: Confirmed submission. I'll post updates in this thread as soon as support replies.

morgan: Perfect — reconvene in-thread when we have quota approvals. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
